title: argo.yaml
description: Deploys the Helm chart in this directory: the applications ApplicationSet generates one ArgoCD Application per environment listed here.

app.description: Application name, unique across the repository.

project.description: ArgoCD project. A chart under apps/ must use product, any other chart platform; the API server rejects any other pairing.

environments.description: Environments the chart is deployed to.

valueFiles.description: Helm value files, relative to this directory. Defaults to the chart's values.yaml.

manifestsValues.description: Values file in nexus-manifests, added as the last value file: CI's deploy job writes the image tag it ships into it.

autoSync.description: Sync automatically, pruning and self-healing. Set to false for an app whose live state is changed by hand and must not be reverted; it then syncs only from the ArgoCD UI.

serverSideApply.description: Sync with server-side apply, for charts whose resources exceed the client-side apply annotation size.

deleteResources.description: Delete the app's resources with its Application. Set to false for resources that must outlive it.
